K2 engine click "pierce/ text=plain div" rejected with zero CDP (GAP-213)
cases.error: Invalid selector "pierce/ text=plain div" — "text=" is Playwright selector-engine syntax (Puppeteer's own text query is spelled "text/"). Use standard CSS or a snapshot node id (e.g. "12"); Puppeteer's pierce/, xpath/, aria/ and text/ prefixes also work for element actions. Playwright-style selectors (text=, role=, >>, :has-text(), getBy*(), internal:) are not supported: to target by visible text or accessible role/name, use click_by_text, click_by_role or type_by_label (CLI: clicktext, clickrole), or take a snapshot and use a node id.
